title: Echo SMP
description: Welcome to the Echo SMP - a survival, community-driven Minecraft SMP.
body:
# Welcome to the Echo SMP

Looking for a survival server that focuses on **community, fairness, and long term progression**? You are in the right place.

Our server is built around a **community driven experience** where players shape the world together. Whether you want to build huge bases, grind the economy, form alliances, or just chill and explore, there is always something happening.

We focus on keeping the server **stable, fair, and enjoyable**, with an active staff team that works hard behind the scenes to maintain a smooth experience for everyone.

---

## 💰 Economy and player progression

The server runs on a **balanced player economy** that rewards effort and creativity.

You can:

* Earn money through gameplay
* Trade with other players
* Buy and sell items in the **server shop**
* Build your wealth and expand your base

The goal is to create a system where **progression feels rewarding without being pay to win**.

---

## 🎁 Crates and rewards

Crates add extra excitement and rewards to your gameplay.

You can obtain keys through:

* Gameplay
* Events
* Community activities

Crates contain a mix of **useful items, rare rewards, and cosmetic perks** to keep things interesting.

---

## 👥 Teams and cooperation

Playing alone is fun, but playing together is even better.

Echo SMP allows players to:

* Create or join **teams**
* Build shared bases
* Work together to gather resources
* Form alliances with other groups

The world grows as players work together and create their own stories.

---

## 🛠️ Dedicated staff team

Our staff team is focused on keeping the server fair and enjoyable for everyone.

You can expect:

* Active moderation
* Fair punishments
* Helpful support for players
* Staff who listen to community feedback

We take server management seriously so the community can enjoy a **stable and welcoming environment**.

---

## ⭐ Why play here?

* Friendly community
* Balanced survival gameplay
* Economy and player shops
* Crates and rewards
* Teams and collaboration
* Active and dedicated staff
* Community driven development

Whether you are a **builder, grinder, explorer, or team leader**, there is a place for you here.

---

Join our server and become part of the community.

---
